title: Discover Lake Tahoe Kayak Tour
includes: Knowledgeable guide trained in CPR/First Aid
requirements: Infants and small children can ride in a pram or stroller
Suitable for all physical fitness levels
policies: Free Parking: First come first served
Umbrellas and chairs are available for an extra fee at the beach tent
cancellation: All sales are final. No refund is available for cancellations.
blurb:
Discover the joy of kayaking on the crystal-clear waters of Lake Tahoe. Under the guidance of our experienced instructors, you’ll learn the fundamentals of this fun and rewarding sport in a relaxed and supportive setting. Your safety is our top priority; all of our guides are certified in First Aid and CPR.

Take in breathtaking alpine views as you glide across the lake, capturing unforgettable moments surrounded by Tahoe’s natural beauty. Along the way, your guides will share fascinating insights into the area’s rich natural and human history. This adventure is the perfect opportunity to connect with loved ones, embrace the tranquility of the mountains, and truly unwind.

All necessary gear is provided, including kayak, paddle, and life jacket, as well as knowledgeable guides and permit fees.

If you are a single traveler, please call the office to see if there is a group to join!
